description: Source code for a command-line interface (CLI) tool 'ssacli' that interacts with SSA functions via provider APIs. It parses command strings, manages provider calls, and handles errors, with support for multiple providers like STOR, CA, IDENT, and MOUNT.

methods.name: cliCheck
methods.description: Enforces basic input syntax, exits if invalid.

methods.name: cleanupVector
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a vector of strings.

methods.name: parseProvCmds
methods.description: Parses provider attribute strings into a vector of individual attribute strings.

methods.name: callProvider
methods.description: Selects and calls the appropriate provider function based on provider name.

methods.name: callCAProvider
methods.description: Stub for handling CA provider commands.

methods.name: callStorProvider
methods.description: Stub for handling Storage provider commands.

methods.name: callIdentProvider
methods.description: Stub for handling Identity provider commands.

methods.name: callMountProvider
methods.description: Handles Mount provider commands, calls rdkssaMount if provider is MOUNT.

methods.name: processCmd
methods.description: Processes a command string, extracts provider and attributes, and invokes provider call.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Logs error messages and exits if specified.

methods.name: climain
methods.description: Main operational function that processes command-line arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point, calls climain or unit test main based on compile flags.
